results.summary_before: The TinyTapeout 7 Factory Test module is a simple design for testing all I/O pins of the ASIC. It has three modes selected by rst_n and sel: mirroring input pins to outputs, mirroring bidirectional pins to outputs, or outputting an 8-bit counter on both output and bidirectional pins. No external hardware is required, and the design has been reported working by multiple testers. It is notable as a dedicated factory test and bring-up utility rather than a functional application.

results.summary_before: This ALU implements the five operators of the INTERCAL programming language, including unary AND/OR/XOR, interleave, and select, operating on 32-bit registers. It is controlled via address, selector, and write/read enable pins, with data transferred through bidirectional and dedicated output pins. The design is primarily educational and can be tested using example calculations from the INTERCAL manual, as included in its test suite. External hardware such as a microcontroller is recommended for driving inputs and reading outputs, as the chip itself has no display or interface.
